title: Users may have experienced alert and activity delays and unexpected CAAC policy behavior in Microsoft Defender XDR

Title: Users may encounter delays for alert, activity processing and unexpected CAAC policy behavior in Microsoft Defender XDR.

User impact: Users may encounter delays for alert, activity processing and unexpected CAAC policy behavior in Microsoft Defender XDR.

More info: For Inline users, access and session policies may not be evaluated as expected, resulting in policies being either bypassed or hardened, depending on the configured behavior.

Additionally, alert processing in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is affected and users may notice generation and visibility be delayed. Email notifications for alerts and downstream systems like Advanced Hunting that consume alert data may experience delayed updates.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry, recent service updates and system logs to isolate the root cause, in order to develop a remediation plan.

Scope of impact: Impact may be specific to any Microsoft Defender XDR user with CAAC session and access policies expecting evaluation. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 9:03 AM UTC

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 3:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may encounter delays for alert, activity processing and unexpected CAAC policy behavior in Microsoft Defender XDR

User impact: Users may encounter delays for alert, activity processing and unexpected CAAC policy behavior in Microsoft Defender XDR.

More info: Specifically, alert and activity processing in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is affected. Users may experience delays in alerts triggered by anomaly detection and activity policies, alert visibility and email notifications. Activity data appearing in the user interface, Advanced Hunting or CloudAppEvents table may also be delayed, potentially affecting the accuracy of custom detections in Microsoft Sentinel.

For Endpoint Inline users with Conditional Access App Control (CAAC), access and session policies may not be evaluated as expected, resulting in policies being either bypassed or hardened, depending on the configured behavior.

Current status: We've confirmed that an authentication component issue is resulting in a section of infrastructure, responsible for alerts and activity processing in Microsoft Defender XDR, to become unavailable of connecting to a dependency service. We've applied performance and traffic optimizations on the infrastructure which has recovered Inline impact as of Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 1:20 PM UTC. In parallel, we've also validated that alert processing has been restored as of Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 1:30 PM UTC and we're monitoring a backlog of activities as it decreases to verify full impact remediation.

Scope of impact: Impact may be specific to any user with CAAC session and access policies or expecting alerts and activities in Microsoft Defender XDR. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: An authentication component issue is resulting in a section of infrastructure, responsible for alerts and activity processing in Microsoft Defender XDR, to become unavailable of connecting to a dependency service.
